title: ODOS-MPI: HPC-Friendly SmartNIC Offloading of Computation/Communication Kernels
problem: Optimizing communication performance in hierarchical multi-GPU systems
motivation: Domain scientists need higher-level abstractions for GPU acceleration
method: The approach extends OpenMP with new pragmas—compiler directives that programmers add to their code—to automatically offload MPI operations (Message Passing Interface, how connected computers exchange data in HPC systems) to SmartNICs (specialized network processor cards). This keeps the main CPU free for computation while the SmartNIC handles communication in multi-GPU clusters, reducing performance bottlenecks in hierarchical systems.
key_novelty: The first OpenMP pragmas designed to enable offloading of Message Passing Interface communication to SmartNICs.
contributions: 18% improvement in atmospheric weather simulation via offloading
